container.title: Application / Docker Container
container.summary: Lightweight, standalone execution environment packaging application code, dependencies, and configuration.
container.details: Containers encapsulate the microservice application so it runs consistently across development, staging, and Azure production environments. In this architecture, containers run your core backend API and background tasks.
container.architectureRole: Packaged as a Docker image, pushed to Azure Container Registry (ACR), and orchestrated across servers using Azure Container Apps (ACA).

ecr.title: Azure Container Registry (ACR)
ecr.summary: Managed private Docker container registry based on open-source Docker Registry 2.0.
ecr.details:
Azure Container Registry stores and manages private container images and related artifacts.

• Best for: Version controlling containerized application builds and securely delivering images to compute targets.
• The Catch: It is strictly a storage registry; pushing an image does nothing until an orchestration service like Azure Container Apps or AKS pulls and runs it.
ecr.architectureRole: Receives container builds from CI/CD and acts as the secure source repository from which Azure Container Apps pulls images.

ecs.title: Azure Container Apps (ACA)
ecs.summary: Fully managed serverless container service built on Kubernetes and open-source standards like Dapr and KEDA.
ecs.details:
Enables deploying microservices and containerized apps without managing underlying cluster infrastructure.

Key Features:
1. Dynamic Auto-scaling: Scales on HTTP traffic, queue lengths (via KEDA), or CPU/memory metrics all the way to zero.
2. Microservice Support: Built-in support for Dapr, distributed tracing, ingress traffic splitting, and revision management.
ecs.architectureRole: Executes backend container tasks behind the Application Gateway and interacts with Azure Database, Redis Cache, and Service Bus.

rds.title: Azure Database for PostgreSQL / MySQL
rds.summary: Fully managed enterprise relational database service with automated patching, high availability, and backups.
rds.details: Automates routine database management tasks including provisioning, automated backups, point-in-time restore, automated patching, scaling, and zone-redundant high availability.
rds.architectureRole: Stores relational structured application data, queried directly by Azure Container Apps and Azure Functions.

sqs.title: Azure Service Bus (Queues)
sqs.summary: Fully managed enterprise message broker with message queues and publish-subscribe topics.
sqs.details:
Service Bus reliably decouples applications and services with message ordering, duplicate detection, and dead-letter queues (DLQs).

• Queues: One-way message delivery guaranteeing First-In-First-Out (FIFO) and at-least-once or at-most-once processing.
• Dead-Letter Sub-queues: Automatically captures unprocessable messages for auditing and retries.
sqs.architectureRole: Buffers background and long-running requests from Container Apps to be consumed asynchronously by worker Azure Functions.

lambda.title: Azure Functions
lambda.summary: Event-driven serverless compute platform enabling developers to run code without managing infrastructure.
lambda.details:
Azure Functions executes code in response to events and triggers, scaling automatically on demand.

In this architecture, Functions serve two core roles:
1. Event-driven post-processing (triggered automatically via Event Grid when a user uploads a blob to Azure Storage).
2. Asynchronous task execution consuming queued messages from Azure Service Bus for jobs taking 5–15 minutes.
lambda.architectureRole: Triggered by Blob upload events and Service Bus queue messages to process data and push notifications via Web PubSub or Email.

ses.title: Azure Communication Services (Email)
ses.summary: Fully managed communication service for sending transactional, operational, and customer alert emails.
ses.details: Provides scalable email delivery with custom domain support, SPF/DKIM authentication, delivery tracking, and analytics dashboards.
ses.architectureRole: Dispatched by worker Functions to send task completion emails, verification links, and customer notifications.

elasticache.title: Azure Cache for Redis
elasticache.summary: Fully managed in-memory data store based on Redis for sub-millisecond data retrieval.
elasticache.details: Significantly reduces database latency and improves application throughput by caching frequently queried database results, user session states, rate limits, and real-time data.
elasticache.architectureRole: Caches hot data for Container Apps and Functions to offload repetitive read queries from Azure Database.

sns.title: Azure Event Grid
sns.summary: Highly scalable, serverless event broker for building reactive, event-driven applications.
sns.details: Event Grid connects data sources and event handlers with near real-time event delivery. Publishers post events to topics, and Event Grid fans them out to multiple subscribers (Functions, Service Bus, webhooks).
sns.architectureRole: Fans out system status changes and operational events to multiple backend consumers and notification webhooks.

elasticache_sns.title: In-Memory Cache & Event Hub (Redis / Event Grid)
elasticache_sns.summary: Combined caching and event distribution cluster managing state speed and real-time event dissemination.
elasticache_sns.details: This composite cluster pairs sub-millisecond caching via Azure Cache for Redis with high-throughput event routing via Event Grid for internal service broadcasting.
elasticache_sns.architectureRole: Provides caching for database query offloading alongside pub/sub event broadcasting for internal microservices.

cloudfront.title: Azure Front Door / Azure CDN
cloudfront.summary: Global, scalable entry-point that combines Content Delivery Network (CDN) and Web Application Firewall (WAF).
cloudfront.details: Leverages Microsoft's global edge network to accelerate web application performance, cache static content close to users, terminate TLS at the edge, and inspect traffic for malicious threats.
cloudfront.architectureRole: Distributes static web frontend assets cached from Azure Blob Storage and securely routes dynamic API traffic toward Application Gateway.

s3.title: Azure Blob Storage
s3.summary: Massively scalable and secure object storage for unstructured data, media, documents, and backups.
s3.details:
Designed for 16 nines of durability with geo-redundancy options.

• Shared Access Signatures (SAS): Grants clients restricted access rights to storage resources for direct uploads (SAS POST) or downloads (SAS GET) without routing heavy payloads through application servers.
s3.architectureRole: Stores user file uploads directly via SAS URLs and triggers worker Azure Functions automatically upon blob landing.

cloudwatch.title: Azure Monitor & Log Analytics
cloudwatch.summary: Comprehensive monitoring solution for collecting, analyzing, and acting on telemetry from Azure and on-premises environments.
cloudwatch.details: Collects metrics, activity logs, and diagnostic traces from Container Apps, Functions, and Databases. Powers Application Insights, alert rules, and automated scaling actions.
cloudwatch.architectureRole: Monitors health metrics across all infrastructure and collects container & serverless logs for debugging and auditing.

route53.title: Azure DNS
route53.summary: High-performance, authoritative DNS hosting service backed by Microsoft's global network of name servers.
route53.details: Provides fast DNS lookups and high availability using anycast networking. Supports alias records pointing directly to Azure Front Door, Traffic Manager, or public IP addresses.
route53.architectureRole: Top-level DNS resolving user domain queries and pointing directly to Azure Front Door edge distribution.

acm.title: App Service Certificates & Azure Key Vault
acm.summary: Integrated certificate provisioning, storage, and automated lifecycle renewal service.
acm.details: Stores and manages SSL/TLS certificates with automated renewals, binding them securely to Azure Front Door and Application Gateway without exposing private keys.
acm.architectureRole: Secures all inbound HTTPS connections by binding validated TLS certificates to Azure Front Door and Application Gateway.

elb.title: Azure Load Balancer
elb.summary: Ultra-low latency Layer 4 load balancer delivering high-throughput distribution for TCP/UDP traffic.
elb.details: Distributes incoming network traffic across backend virtual machine instances or container endpoints based on IP protocols and port health probes.
elb.architectureRole: Distributes incoming traffic across backend infrastructure and internal microservice endpoints.

alb.title: Azure Application Gateway
alb.summary: Web traffic load balancer that enables managing traffic to web applications based on HTTP request attributes.
alb.details: Supports URL path-based routing, multi-site hosting, cookie-based session affinity, SSL termination, and integrated Web Application Firewall (WAF).
alb.architectureRole: Receives decrypted traffic from Azure Front Door and routes REST API requests to healthy Container App tasks.

elb_alb.title: Ingress & Load Balancing (App Gateway / Azure LB)
elb_alb.summary: Traffic ingress and distribution cluster managing Layer 7 HTTP routing and Layer 4 load balancing.
elb_alb.details: Combines Application Gateway for URL routing and WAF inspection with load-balanced backend pools for high availability across availability zones.
elb_alb.architectureRole: Acts as the single entry point for API traffic reaching the backend container infrastructure.

iam.title: Microsoft Entra ID & Azure RBAC
iam.summary: Universal identity platform and role-based access control governing permissions for users and cloud services.
iam.details: Enforces least-privilege security using Managed Identities for Azure resources, allowing Container Apps and Functions to access Azure SQL, Storage, and Key Vault without storing credentials in code.
iam.architectureRole: Grants secure Managed Identities allowing Container Apps and Functions to access Blob Storage, SQL, and Service Bus.

parameter_store.title: Azure App Configuration & Key Vault
parameter_store.summary: Centralized configuration management service paired with hardware security module (HSM) secrets storage.
parameter_store.details: App Configuration centralizes application settings and feature flags, while Key Vault securely safeguards encryption keys, database passwords, and API secrets.
parameter_store.architectureRole: Supplies encrypted database connection strings and configuration keys to containers and Functions on startup.

opensearch.title: Azure AI Search (Cognitive Search)
opensearch.summary: Enterprise search service with rich indexing, full-text search, and AI-powered vector similarity capabilities.
opensearch.details: Enables sub-second search queries across millions of documents with fuzzy matching, faceted navigation, geospatial filtering, semantic ranker, and vector search.
opensearch.architectureRole: Powers high-speed application search queries and real-time faceted exploration alongside primary relational data.

api_gateway.title: Azure Web PubSub / Azure SignalR
api_gateway.summary: Fully managed real-time messaging service with native WebSocket support for bidirectional streaming.
api_gateway.details:
Maintains persistent, stateful WebSocket connections with client devices.

When long-running asynchronous tasks (5–15 minutes) complete, backend worker Functions broadcast live completion notifications directly back to users without requiring client polling.
api_gateway.architectureRole: Maintains active WebSocket links with clients to push notifications when asynchronous tasks finish.

cloudflare.title: Cloudflare
cloudflare.summary: Global CDN, DNS, and DDoS protection layer positioned at the Internet perimeter before Azure origins.
cloudflare.details: Provides edge caching, Web Application Firewall (WAF) rule sets, bot management, and SSL termination before routing legitimate traffic to Azure Front Door or Azure DNS.
cloudflare.architectureRole: Acts as the outermost internet security shield and DNS proxy guarding the architecture against malicious traffic.

user.title: End User / Web Client
user.summary: End-user web browser or mobile client initiating HTTP requests, WebSocket streams, and file transfers.
user.details: Clients fetch static assets from Azure Front Door, connect to Azure Web PubSub via WebSockets for real-time progress updates, and upload files directly to Azure Blob Storage via SAS URLs without loading application servers.
user.architectureRole: Interacts with Azure Front Door for assets, Web PubSub for live alerts, and Blob Storage for direct uploads.

admin.title: Administrator Client
admin.summary: System administrator or staff member accessing administrative panels, metrics dashboards, and configuration tools.
admin.details: Admins access operational views, monitor Azure Monitor metrics, inspect AI Search analytics, and manage application configurations stored in Azure App Configuration and Key Vault.
admin.architectureRole: Consumes administrative APIs and observability dashboards to monitor system health and perform operational duties.
